_meta.purpose: Scored backlog of candidate upstream sources. Hand-curated URLs + DB-derived damCount via bin/score_sources.ts.
_meta.scoring: yieldScore = damCount × cadenceWeight × legalWeight ÷ adapterCost; weights: hourly=24, daily=1, 10d=0.1, unknown=0.5; legalWeight: open=1, mixed=0.4, blocked=0.05; adapterCost: html-table=1, js-rendered=3, xml=1, pdf=5, unknown=2
